problem_statement.value: Why does the manual shifter in my 2021 Honda Civic SE feel hesitant, grinding, and uncertain between second and third gear when the car is cold, especially after a night of parking? The car has 98,000 miles, no warning lights, no recent crashes. I want to understand the root mechanical cause and how the shift mechanism could be redesigned so the gear engagement stays crisp and unambiguous in all temperatures.
